Vendored from TuxBox (github.com/brcly/TuxBox) 938c402: the Rust console-library providers under runtime/ (GameInput abi.cpp is ported to Rust as gameinput/src/abi.rs), used by i95's `--runtime tuxbox` path. Test guests, Python tooling and the Proton-only shader prep are left out. runtime/dxbc is Apache-2.0; the rest of TuxBox ships no top-level license. i95 carries local runtime fixes on top (view translation, shadow buffers over split title pages, diagnostics); see the top-level README and CREDITS.md.
